representative_cases.input_requirement: 28.	Exporting a Job to a BIAR File1. Log into the LifeCycle Manager tool, and create a new job. To export the BIAR file to an FTP location, select FTP. Enter appropriate details in the host, port, username, password, directory, and filename fields.10. Click Export.The BIAR file is exported to an FTP location.
